column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3: Pulta encounter and armor awakening
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: As expected, only the chosen can wield the armor properly!
Tch, you useless fools!
Never mind! There are plenty more bodies for the armor!
You, go too! Go die with them using the armor's power!
N-nooo!
I don't want to obey you, even if I have to die!
T-that voice... Could it be $$パルタ$$? $$パルタ$$, is that you?
You bastard!!
You're only hired help!
I'll kill you with my own hands!!
Aaaaaaah!
T-that's awful!!
Even if it is an $$大邪神$$ armor filled with tremendous power,
there is only a flesh-and-blood person inside! Be reduced to dust before my magic!
T-that's horrible... To treat your own companion so cruelly!
To live in $$自由$$... you really do need great strength!
$$パルタ$$!? Is that really $$パルタ$$?
What's with the musclehead and $$ピリポ$$? The enemy's right in front of them...
Honestly! What are white $$羽$$ people thinking?
So it really is $$パルタ$$?
Brother... Is that really you, Brother?
Why... are you wearing something like that?!
I'm sorry.
Ever since we were little... I hated you for being such a coward, Brother...
After you went to $$ゴルゴダ$$...
I trained to become stronger...
became Lord $$マモン$$'s subordinate...
and by wearing this $$大邪神$$ armor, I tried to convince myself that I was strong...
But...
But that was only because I did not want to admit my own weakness...
That's not true...
You were always smart, athletic, and strong!
Strength that relies on a title like that... was not real strength...
No matter how much you were bullied, Brother, you never...
ran from that reality...
or tried to rely on something else...
The one who had true strength was... Broth...
No! $$パルタ$$aaaaa!
He looked strong too, but...
no matter how strong a $$奴隷$$ becomes, can he never be $$自由$$ for life?!
I'm not strong! But right now, I want to become very strong!!
Movie: $$レブ$$ & $$ピリポ$$ equip armor
A power neither white nor black!
Great power.
New power.
What are you trying to do?!
Don't tell me, that armor?!
Stop! You cannot do it...
That is just like then!
The Advent of the $$邪神$$!!
